datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments and spatial data collection to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data for October, November, and December 2020 were compiled and distributed in GeoJSON and KML formats to represent current food insecurity situations across Rwanda.
